headline: Jesse Butterfield marries paper and metal in A Veiled Boundary exhibition
context: Sewn paper and hand-hammered steel sit side by side in these lighting pieces and stools by designer Jesse Butterfield, displayed during London Design Festival 2026. The aptly named Sew Paper Lighting and Stool Des Pois series premiered during Butterfield's A Veil Boundary exhibit

sources.name: Dezeen
sources.summary: Sewn paper and hand-hammered steel sit side by side in these lighting pieces and stools by designer Jesse Butterfield, displayed during London Design Festival 2026. The aptly named Sew Paper Lighting and Stool Des Pois series premiered during Butterfield's A Veil Boundary exhibition, curated by Alex Tieghi-Walker, in the city-wide festival's Brompton Design District.
